excerpt: The short recall at the start made me notice what I actually could not explain.
I remembered definitions, but the best part was having to connect two ideas without notes.
Some days it felt repetitive when I already knew the topic.
Checking my answer immediately helped me change how I studied that night.
The quiz score went up, but I still felt unsure when the question looked different.
I started reviewing by trying to answer first instead of rereading everything.
